case-studies.title: 94% More Site Conversions in Six Months for AILBS
case-studies.client: AILBS — Dr. Vivek Vij's liver transplant practice
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital built a digital presence from the ground up for Dr. Vivek Vij's liver transplant practice, bringing in national and international patient enquiries.

results.label: More site conversions in six months

case-studies.content:
Industry: Liver Transplantation & Hepatobiliary Sciences · Location: Delhi NCR & Chandigarh · Timeframe: Six months.

About the client

Dr. Vivek Vij is a liver transplant surgeon and Director of the Department of Liver Transplantation & Gastrointestinal Surgery at Fortis Healthcare, across Fortis Escorts, FMRI, Fortis Noida and Fortis Chandigarh. He founded AILBS, the Advanced Institute of Liver & Biliary Sciences, within the Fortis group of hospitals.

The challenge

Despite years of clinical experience, the practice had almost no presence online.

  • No digital presence: without a website or social channels, the practice couldn't reach patients beyond existing referrals.
  • A need for quality enquiries: Dr. Vij wanted serious patient enquiries from across India and from abroad.
  • Too little content to rank: the website didn't have enough useful content to appear for important liver care searches.

Our approach

We built the practice's digital presence in three layers. First, visibility: a mobile-first website, search optimisation and a strong Google listing. Next, trust: educational content on liver health and treatment. Finally, enquiries: lead-generation campaigns reaching patients in India and overseas.

What we did

01 · SEO and content

Keyword research at local and national level, optimised treatment pages and regular blogs on liver care, so the site ranked for the searches patients actually make.

02 · Google Maps listing

A complete Google Business Profile with accurate details, weekly photos and videos, and two posts every week to keep the listing active and visible.

03 · Mobile-first website

Clear navigation across every page and well-placed calls to action, built for patients browsing on their phones.

04 · International lead-generation ads

Campaigns targeting patients in India and abroad, designed to bring quality enquiries rather than high volumes of unqualified leads.

05 · Social media management

Facebook, Instagram, Twitter and LinkedIn channels built from scratch, sharing liver care awareness, healthy living tips and short video explainers.

Services used: SEO · Google Maps & Local SEO · Website Development · PPC Management · Social Media Marketing.

Results by channel

Search

  • 223% — more organic clicks
  • 467% — more search impressions
  • 170% — more traffic, with all target keywords in average position
  • 87% — more traffic from new users

Social media

  • 503% — Instagram engagement growth
  • 422% — Facebook engagement growth
  • 227% — Twitter engagement growth
  • 162% — LinkedIn engagement growth

Key learnings

Clear cost information drives demand

Pages explaining the cost of liver transplants in India saw some of the strongest growth. Patients facing major surgery want honest, upfront information before they enquire.

Mobile comes first

With most traffic arriving on mobile, a fast, simple mobile experience was essential, not optional.

A consistent listing keeps working

Weekly posts, photos and videos kept the Google listing fresh, supporting steady search visibility and calls.

case-studies.title: 1,000+ Leads in Three Months for PSRI Hospital
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital helped a Delhi multi-speciality hospital attract national and international patients for specialised treatment, through focused search campaigns and SEO.
case-studies.content:
Industry: Multi-speciality hospital · Location: Delhi · Timeframe: First three months of the campaign.

About the client

PSRI Hospital is a multi-speciality hospital in Delhi. It treats patients from across NCR, other parts of India and overseas who travel for specialised care.

The challenge

  • Reaching international patients: the hospital wanted more patients from abroad for super-speciality treatment.
  • Building organic presence: its search visibility was too limited to bring steady enquiries.
  • Generating quality enquiries: it needed serious enquiries from India and overseas, not just more traffic.

Our approach

We focused on two channels: Google Ads for fast, targeted enquiries, and SEO for lasting visibility. Every treatment got its own landing page, and every campaign was judged on lead quality, not volume.

What we did

01 · Treatment-specific search campaigns

Keyword-specific ad copy for organ transplant and other specialised treatments, raising the average keyword Quality Score to 8.

02 · Mobile-first landing pages

A dedicated landing page for each treatment, covering the hospital, its doctors, infrastructure and facilities.

03 · On-page SEO and UX

Treatment-based keyword groups, stronger on-page SEO and UI changes that made the site easier to use.

04 · Google Business Profile

A well-drafted listing for better local presence, updated with fresh images and content every week.

05 · In-content enquiry forms and FAQs

Enquiry boxes placed within treatment pages, plus FAQ sections with schema to answer common patient questions.

Services used: Google Ads Management · SEO · Google Maps & Local SEO · Landing Page Design.

Results by channel

Paid search

  • 1,000+ — leads in the first three months
  • 20% — lower cost per lead, month on month
  • 43% — higher click-through rate
  • 120% — better lead quality

SEO and website

  • 150% — stronger organic presence from the first month
  • 40% — more organic traffic
  • 23% — more leads from treatment pages

Key learnings

Every treatment needs its own page

Dedicated landing pages for each treatment improved lead quality, because patients found exactly the information they were looking for.

Relevance lowers cost

Keyword-specific ads raised Quality Scores, which brought higher click-through rates and a falling cost per lead.

Make enquiring easy

Placing enquiry forms inside treatment pages captured patients at the moment they were most interested.

case-studies.title: 220% More Leads Across Hyderabad and Bengaluru
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital helped National Dental Care grow enquiries, local visibility and brand recognition across its clinic network.
case-studies.content:
Industry: Dental clinic network · Location: Hyderabad & Bengaluru · Timeframe: During our engagement.

About the client

National Dental Care is a network of dental clinics across Hyderabad, including Madinaguda, Kukatpally, Dilsukhnagar and Gachibowli, and Bengaluru, including HSR Layout, Whitefield and Sarjapur. It offers general, advanced and cosmetic dental treatments.

The challenge

  • Low clinic footfall: the clinics needed more enquiries and patient visits.
  • Limited brand recognition: the network was not yet well known in Telangana and Bengaluru.
  • Low oral health awareness: patients didn't understand the link between oral health and overall health.

Our approach

We combined local search, performance campaigns and education. Each clinic was optimised to win its own neighbourhood, campaigns targeted high-value treatments, and social content built awareness of oral health.

What we did

01 · Google Maps for every clinic

Business Profiles optimised for each location, with accurate name, address and phone details and weekly monitoring.

02 · Location-specific SEO

City and treatment pages built for each locality, competing with directories like Practo for local searches.

03 · Performance campaigns

Mobile-first landing pages, strong calls to action and detailed tracking, with ad copy designed to beat local competitors.

04 · Treatment awareness video ads

Short video ads promoting aligners, dental implants and braces to a large audience.

05 · Social media management

Educational posts linking oral health and overall health, alongside timely moment-marketing content.

Services used: SEO · Google Maps & Local SEO · Google Ads Management · Video Advertising · Social Media Marketing.

Results by channel

SEO

  • 2,286% — more organic clicks
  • 297% — more organic impressions
  • 131% — more top-10 keyword rankings

Paid campaigns

  • 70% — better lead quality
  • 42% — lower cost per lead
  • 45% — lower cost per click

Key learnings

Every clinic competes locally

Each location needed its own listing, keywords and page to win searches in its neighbourhood.

Branded searches follow expansion

Searches for "National Dental Care" plus a locality rose sharply as the network grew into Bengaluru.

Video builds demand for advanced treatments

Short video ads made patients aware of aligners and implants before they started searching.

case-studies.title: 232% Organic Traffic Growth in One Year for Elite Dental Studio
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital helped a Kerala dental chain grow visibility, enquiries and brand recognition across three cities.

results.label: Organic traffic growth in one year
Lower cost per lead in those campaigns

case-studies.content:
Industry: Dental clinic chain · Location: Calicut, Kochi & Kannur · Timeframe: One year (organic traffic).

About the client

Elite Dental Studio is a chain of dental clinics in Calicut, Kochi and Kannur. It draws patients from across Kerala for advanced dental treatments.

The challenge

  • A gap in clinic visits: the clinics had more capacity than patients, and needed more enquiries and appointments.
  • Low brand recognition: despite a strong presence across Kerala, few potential patients knew the brand.
  • Low oral health awareness: patients needed to understand how oral health affects overall wellbeing.

Our approach

We built local search visibility in all three cities first, then added campaigns. Search ads captured patients already looking for a dentist, while video campaigns created demand for advanced treatments.

What we did

01 · Local SEO and Google Maps

Targeted keywords and optimised Business Profiles for Calicut, Kochi and Kannur, helping the brand stand out locally.

02 · Listing management

Consistent name, address and phone details across every listing, with weekly audits of user-suggested changes.

03 · Content optimisation

City and treatment pages refined for dental implants and root canal treatment, competing with directories like Practo.

04 · Search campaigns

Engaging ad copy with callouts and extensions, plus mobile-first landing pages with clear calls to action.

05 · Treatment awareness video ads

Short video ads promoting aligners, dental implants and braces, reaching millions of viewers.

Services used: SEO · Google Maps & Local SEO · Google Ads Management · Video Advertising · Landing Page Design.

Results by channel

SEO

  • 150% — more top-10 keyword rankings
  • 365% — more organic impressions
  • 212% — more organic clicks

Search campaigns

  • 30% — more leads
  • 46% — better lead quality
  • 28% — lower cost per click
  • 15% — lower cost per lead

Treatment awareness campaigns

  • 47% — better lead quality
  • 42% — lower cost per click

Key learnings

Awareness can outperform search

In a competitive local market, treatment awareness campaigns delivered far stronger lead growth than search ads alone.

Local content beats directories

City-specific treatment pages helped the clinics compete with large directories for local searches.

Accurate listings need regular checks

Weekly audits kept every listing accurate, protecting local visibility across all three cities.

SEO

Focusing on specific areas like Tambaram and the OMR corridor helped each clinic win searches in its own neighbourhood.

case-studies.title: 333% More Leads Across 125+ Partha Dental Clinics
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital helped a South Indian dental, skin and hair clinic chain grow enquiries across four states, while bringing down the cost of every lead.
case-studies.content:
Industry: Dental, skin & hair clinic chain · Location: Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka & Tamil Nadu · Timeframe: During our engagement.

About the client

Partha Dental, Skin & Hair Clinics is a healthcare chain with over 125 clinics across Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu. It offers dental, skin and hair treatments in cities including Hyderabad, Bangalore and Chennai.

The challenge

  • Increasing clinic footfall: the chain needed more enquiries and visits across its clinics in South India.
  • Standing out in big cities: competition in Hyderabad, Bangalore and Chennai made it hard to be noticed.
  • Educating patients: patients needed to understand how oral, skin and hair health affect overall wellbeing.

Our approach

We focused on performance campaigns built for local and regional competition. Search ads captured patients ready to book, video ads built demand for advanced treatments, and mobile-first landing pages turned interest into enquiries.

What we did

01 · Performance search campaigns

Ad copy with callouts and extensions for dental, skin and hair treatments, designed to rank prominently in key cities.

02 · Treatment awareness video ads

Targeted video ads for aligners, dental implants, laser skin treatments and hair restoration, reaching millions of potential patients.

03 · Mobile-first landing pages

Treatment-specific pages with clear calls to action and detailed tracking, making enquiries and bookings simple.

04 · Social media management

Educational content on oral, skin and hair health, plus moment-marketing posts around trending topics and regional events.

05 · Brand positioning

Campaigns that highlighted advanced technology and patient-focused care, building trust and encouraging clinic visits.

Services used: Google Ads Management · Video Advertising · Landing Page Design · Social Media Marketing.

Results by channel

Paid campaigns

  • 44% — higher click-through rate
  • 41.5% — better lead quality
  • 45% — lower cost per lead

Key learnings

Large networks need local campaigns

With more than 125 clinics, campaigns had to compete city by city rather than run as one national campaign.

Video creates demand for advanced treatments

Short video ads introduced patients to aligners, laser treatments and hair restoration before they began searching.

Landing pages decide lead quality

Treatment-specific pages with clear calls to action improved lead quality while lowering cost per lead.

case-studies.title: 111 Site Conversions From Organic Search Alone
case-studies.excerpt: How Reinvent Digital grew UrgentDent's visibility and enquiries in Northwest Indiana, without paid ads or social media campaigns.
case-studies.content:
Industry: Emergency & family dentistry · Location: Northwest Indiana, USA · Timeframe: During our engagement.

About the client

UrgentDent is an emergency dental provider in Northwest Indiana, offering family, general and cosmetic dentistry for over 15 years. Its multilingual team offers extended hours and accepts major insurance plans.

The challenge

  • Increasing clinic visits: the practice needed more enquiries and appointments.
  • Building local recognition: it needed stronger brand presence across Northwest Indiana.
  • Educating patients: patients needed to understand how oral health affects overall wellbeing.

Our approach

We relied entirely on organic search. Local SEO, Google Maps and content optimisation were designed to capture patients searching for urgent and everyday dental care.

What we did

01 · Local SEO and Google Maps

Business Profiles optimised for each location, targeting high-traffic local keywords across Northwest Indiana.

02 · Listing management

Accurate name, address and phone details, with weekly monitoring of user-suggested changes.

03 · Emergency dental content

Treatment pages refined for emergency care, cosmetic dentistry and check-ups, with FAQ sections and schema.

04 · Mobile landing pages and CTAs

Clear calls to action on treatment pages, making it easy to schedule appointments or contact the team.

Services used: SEO · Google Maps & Local SEO · Website Optimisation.

Results by channel

SEO

  • 133% — more organic traffic
  • 27% — more top-10 keyword rankings
  • 26% — more organic impressions
  • 11% — more organic clicks

Key learnings

SEO alone can drive conversions

Without any paid ads, organic search and Google Maps delivered steady site conversions.

Urgent searches need clear answers

Content built around emergency dental care matched what patients search for when they need help quickly.

Make booking effortless

Simple, visible calls to action on mobile turned visitors into appointment requests.
